composition_subtypes.role: Sort intervals by l_i descending to support greedy selection of which employees to boost to at least median.
Binary search over possible median values to find maximum feasible median.

payload.core_composition_summary: Binary search for max median with greedy selection over intervals sorted by l_i descending.
payload.rationale: Sorting defines order for greedy check within binary search; the check iterates in descending l_i to minimize extra cost needed to reach candidate median.
